comment: USER 2026-10-22 (Arcanum Wings: "it shouldn't lose any options for the user") -- CHOICE 1 of 2 from the same position as bruna_human_wings_swap_combat_choice. Bruna T5: Mother of Runes (untapped, can attack) wears Arcanum Wings, three Seaside Citadels, Colossification in hand, opponent at 21. The human commits the MAIN-PHASE swap `auraswap=Colossification`: it happens where it was queued, in main 1 (no longer moved to combat): Colossification's ETB taps Mother, she cannot attack, the opponent stays at 21. Under the 2026-10-06..22 rule this option did not exist (the swap was moved to combat); that rule now only replays the references stamped `combat_swap_timing` (bruna_human_wings_swap_deferred_to_combat).
